# Erdos.p218 — Erdős problem 218

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/218
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/218.lean`, theorem `erdos_218.variants.le`, AMS 11).

The set of indices $n$ for which a prime gap is followed by a larger or equal prime gap has a
natural density of $\frac 1 2$.

## Statement
{n | primeGap n ≤ primeGap (n + 1)}.HasDensity <| 1 / 2

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
